episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her journey of using YouTube as a powerful lead generation tool, emphasizing the importance of consistency and patience. She discusses the challenges of starting a YouTube channel, the benefits of hiring an editor, and the rewarding experience of working with clients who find her through YouTube. The episode provides actionable insights for agents looking to expand their lead generation strategies through video content.
